messages.subject: time series data
parts:
Hello -- I am trying to chart sales and price time series data for
items on the same chart. Here's one approach:

===========================
library(ggplot2)
df <- data.frame(
sid = c(rep('11',30),rep('22',30),rep('33',30)),
time = rep(ISOdate(year=2010, month = 1, day = 1:30), 3),
sales = c(rnorm(30, 1000, 20), rnorm(30, 900, 10), rnorm(30, 600,
10)),
price = c(rnorm(30, 2, 0.5), rnorm(30, 3,0.5), rnorm(30, 6,0.5))
)
df2 <- melt(df, id = 1:2)

ggplot(df2, aes(x=time, y=value, group=sid, colour=sid)) + theme_bw()
+
geom_line(data=subset(df2, variable=='sales'), size=1) +
geom_point(data=subset(df2, variable=='price'), size=1) +
facet_wrap(variable~sid, nrow=2, scales='free_y')
===========================

Typically, I would like to compare multiple items (say >6) at one time
and would like to figure if there was a way to incorporporate the
price data in the same chart as the sales data. One approach to do
this would be to scale the price of an item by its max_price (1 -
price(item,time)/max_price(item)) and display that using fill for a
geom_tile.

Can somebody please show me how to plot geom_tile at the top of the
sales chart? An alternative approach which plots in the same chart is
also welcome.

Thanks.

df <- merge(df, aggregate(df$price, by=list(sid=df$sid), max),
by="sid", all.x=TRUE)
df$discount <- 1 - df$price/df$x
df <- df[,-match(c("price","x"),colnames(df))]

# Low tech solution
ggplot(df, aes(x=time, y=sales)) +
geom_path(colour="#502771") +
geom_point(aes(colour=discount), size=4) +
facet_grid(sid~., scale="free_y")


# Draw rectangles behind the data
# width = half of the time step of the data
# manual: half a day
deltat <- 0.5*3600*24
# automatic
deltat <- ddply(df, ~sid, function(x) {
d <- diff(x$time)
units(d) <- "secs"
d <- unique(d)
return(c(deltat=d/2))
})
df <- merge(df, deltat)

ggplot(df) +
geom_rect(aes(xmin=time-deltat, xmax=time+deltat, ymin=min(sales),
ymax=max(sales), fill=discount, group=sid)) +
geom_path(aes(x=time, y=sales)) +
facet_grid(sid~., scale="free_y")
# Does not work: does not compute the min/max per facet/group

# compute min and max per sid manually
mm <- ddply(df, ~sid, function(x) range(x$sales)+c(-10,10))
df <- merge(df, mm)

ggplot(df) +
geom_rect(aes(xmin=time-deltat, xmax=time+deltat, ymin=V1,
ymax=V2, fill=discount, group=sid), alpha=0.7) +
geom_path(aes(x=time, y=sales)) +
facet_grid(sid~., scale="free_y")
